title: ComputeLimitState
description: What the researcher was told about a project's agent compute limit, so a burst of refusals or one crossing notifies once.

project_id.title: ProjectId
project_id.description: Stable project identifier (lowercase slug). Never a path; paths live in the local registry.

refused.title: ComputeLimitRefusals
refused.description: Agent submissions refused since the last admitted one under this policy revision: one notification per burst.

first_at.title: Timestamp
first_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a `Z` suffix and optional fractional seconds.

last_at.title: Timestamp
last_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a `Z` suffix and optional fractional seconds.

over_limit_since.title: Timestamp
over_limit_since.description: When the hours used went over the limit (a remote clock or an import can push them past it); cleared once they are within it again.
